title: SystemOne Trade-Off Jev Request Schema
description: Extended /v1/systemone single-forward-pass decision request supporting dynamic Preference Tables (T_{t-1}), cold-start goal schemas (t=0), standard primitives (noul, choice, score), and AAT-conditioned tradeoff_noul questions.

CandidateOption.description: A candidate action or proposition evaluated in a trade-off decision.

id.description: Unique identifier for the candidate option (e.g., 'ship_hotfix_now', 'delay_for_audit').

proposition.description: Natural-language proposition or action description evaluated for a conditioned noul P(yes | x_t, T_t).

description.description: Optional additional context or parameters for this specific candidate.

is_status_quo.description: Whether this option represents the status quo / routine alternative (Selten 1999, Section 2.4).

NoulQuestion.description: Standard SystemOne/Jev binary Bernoulli primitive returning P(true) in [0, 1].

prompt.description: Proposition whose truth/approval probability is queried.

ChoiceQuestion.description: Standard SystemOne/Jev categorical choice primitive returning a probability distribution over options.

ScoreQuestion.description: Standard SystemOne/Jev ordinal rubric primitive returning distribution and expected score over levels 0 .. L-1.

TradeOffNoulQuestion.description: Extended Trade-Off Jev primitive: evaluates a proposition or set of candidate options against the adapted Preference Table T_t, returning conditioned noul probabilities P(yes | x_t, T_t), goal-level expectations, and feasibility.

prompt.description: Primary trade-off proposition or decision prompt (e.g., 'Should we deploy Candidate A to production now?').

candidate_id.description: Optional reference to a specific entry in the top-level 'candidates' array.

candidates.description: Optional inline trade-off candidates affecting feasibility and aspiration adaptation in step t.

adaptation_mode.description: Controls whether T_{t-1} is adapted to T_t before conditioning the noul ('auto_adapt'), kept frozen ('fixed_table'), or initialized from x_0 ('cold_start_infer').

model.description: Identifier of the SystemOne / Trade-Off Jev model.

state.description: Environmental context / state x_t (text or structured JSON object describing current observations, constraints, and candidate properties).

goal_schema.description: Incommensurable goal definitions G = (g_1, ..., g_m) with ordered rubric levels.

preference_table.description: Prior Preference Table T_{t-1} from the previous Markov step. At t=0 (cold start), this may be null or omitted so the model initializes T_0 from state x_0 and goal_schema.

cold_start_strategy.description: Strategy used when preference_table is null at t=0.

candidates.description: Available action alternatives in state x_t against which feasibility of the aspiration vector is tested.

questions.description: List of decision primitives to evaluate in a single forward pass.
